correctness.rationale: Verified Lemmas 1-3 and blow-up step independently. Lemma1: E-normalization c_eps and H-lower bound c_H=(2pi)^{3/2}/(64 sqrt(4pi/3))~0.12024>=0.12 reproduced by rerunning disproof_ledger.py. Lemma2: x-homogeneous data gives S_{B0}(t)psi=e^{-nu t}psi with nu<=|v|+sqrt(8/pi)<=2.5957<=2.6 on |v|<=1, reproduced. Lemma3: Duhamel remainder B(t)=t||K||_{E->H}sup||S|| finite eps-uniform given K:E->H and K:E->E finiteness (Grad/Povzner, Alonso-Carneiro-Gamba Young, Mouhot-Strain, GMM memoir) plus S_{B0} contractions on E and H; Pi bounds via m0=1, m1=11^{-1/2}(12/11)^{-6}~0.1789, m4=sqrt(3/2) and Gaussian moments giving ||Pi||_{E->H}<=1374.2, ||Pi||_{E->E}<5.6e8 reproduced. Triangle then gives ||S(t)(I-Pi)psi_eps||_H>=e^{-2.6t}0.12 eps^{-3/2}-B(t)-C'(t)->inf for each fixed t>0, hence operator norm +inf and 60 t^{-5/2} false, indeed no finite (C,alpha) works. Mollification extends to smooth data via E- and H-convergence and E->H continuity. ADMISSION_DEFECT: topic audit_preflight/triviality claim that E embeds continuously into H is false (E not subset H already at t=0, as witness shows); the disproof goes essentially beyond t=0 by proving persistence under dynamics, so it is not a definitional vacuity.

The transport-ball obstruction is not mechanically implied by abstract enlargement (which leaves blow-up symbolic) nor by non-cutoff theory, and no table/database tabulates this operator norm. Hence the qualitative no-finite-envelope disproof is new.

value.rationale: The headline is a rigorous negative resolution of the admitted target that is stronger than falsifying (60,5/2): it proves ||S(t)(I-Pi)||_{E->H}=+inf for every t>0 with explicit transport-dominated v-ball witnesses, showing cutoff hard-sphere short-time L1_v L_inf_x to L2 ultracontractivity is qualitatively impossible (contrast Fokker-Planck). This is an independently retrievable sharpness benchmark that blocks the smoothing route, guides splitting/weight choice, and prevents over-claiming in nonlinear stability bootstraps. ADMISSION_DEFECT noted above (false E-embeds-into-H preflight) does not reduce this to cheap vacuity/type error: the t>0 persistence requires the Duhamel uniform-remainder ledger, as Admission's own negative-resolution rationale anticipated as PASS-worthy enlargement science.
